vue.accepting_eRequests_description: Check this box when your listing is ready to accept eRequests. Billing is immediately applied based on the eRequest subscription selected above.
vue.test_mode_description: Use test mode to test your listing before going live.
vue.hide_listing_non_test_users: Hide this listing from users who are not using test mode
vue.auto_split_requests: Automatically split requests with multiple services into separate requests
vue.require_physician_or_np: Requester must be a physician or NP
vue.wait_dynamic_url: Wait for a dynamic external URL on request creation
vue.ask_user_communication_responsibility: Ask the user which site should have communication responsibilities for the request
vue.revert_communication_responsibility: Revert communication responsibilities for the request to the previous owner
vue.retain_communication_responsibility: Retain communication responsibilities for the request at my site
vue.service_request_repository_description: Service Request Repositories collect referral data to help health systems with resource planning and allocation.
vue.regional_authority_description: A Regional Authority may approve and grant Ocean licenses under a provincial or other regional contract. If you are participating in a provincial program, you may be instructed to apply to a Regional Authority.
vue.completed_no_appt: eRequests completed without an appointment in Ocean
vue.managed_externally: eRequests managed externally and not updated in Ocean
vue.listing_last_modified: Listing last modified by: {whom} on {date} at {time}
vue.fees_covered_by_ra: Fees covered by regional authority program

vue.add_services_description: Add services that your listing will support. You can further customize the display and function of any selected offering in the sections below.
vue.form_select_info: Select an Ocean eForm to use as this offering’s request form. This form will be shown instead of the default eRequest form (if one is set).
vue.remove_service_are_you_sure: Are you sure you want to remove this health service and its associated information?
vue.favourite_cleared_message: The regional favourite is cleared. Check the map view to confirm. (The status is not displayed here.)
vue.prompt_to_configure_catchment_area: This service uses a catchment area. Please proceed to configure the catchment area in the subsequent dialog.
vue.can_set_catchment_area_at_listing_level: Alternatively, you may set a catchment area for the entire listing.
vue.automatically_update_to_listing_email: Automatically updates to match this listing’s eRequest notification email(s).
vue.notification_email_description: Which email(s) should receive eRequest notifications for this offering. Multiple emails must be separated by commas and semicolons.

vue.listing_purpose_description: A Directory Listing provides contact information, additional details, and Health Service Offerings for a specialist, clinic, or other healthcare provider on the Ocean Healthmap. They also indicate if that physician/program/provider is accepting eRequests.
vue.modifies_send_button_description: Modifies the send button and notification text for this listing.
vue.patient_facining_email_description: Provided to patients in eRequest notification emails.
vue.hide_address_healthmap: Hide address on the Ocean Healthmap
vue.organization_description: The selected organization's title and logo will appear beside the listing's name in search results.
vue.emr_assignment_message_group: This section is only applicable if a Directory Listing is specific to a single healthcare provider.
vue.emr_assignment_message: This information affects EMR task assignment. It is stored and maintained independently from any Clinician Information stored within individual Ocean user accounts.
vue.appointment_label_description: Labels determine which appointment dates are used in wait time calculations.
vue.form_select_info: Select an Ocean eForm to use as the default request form for this listing’s Health Service Offerings.
vue.central_intake_listing_description: Central Intakes triage eConsults and/or eReferrals based on region and pathway. By adding a Central Intake to your listing, consults and/or referrals sent to this listing will be routed to the Central Intake.
vue.automatically_update_to_site_email: Automatically updates to match your site’s default notification email(s).
vue.notification_email_description: Multiple emails must be separated by commas or semicolons.
